## Client / freelance job

`project` is a client / freelance job workspace (`job.yaml` at the root).
Start a new review round by copying `review/_template/` to `review/rNN/`.

### Layout

- `brief/`: Read-only client brief and scope as received.
- `contract/`: Read-only signed contract, SOW, NDA and change orders.
- `comms/`: Dated summaries of calls, emails and decisions.
- `refs/`: Read-only client references and brand kit.
- `intake/`: Read-only files received from the client, in dated folders.
- `licences/`: Licences for fonts, stock and music used here.
- `work/`: All working files for the job.
- `review/`: One folder per review round (`r01`, `r02` ...; copy `review/_template/`).
- `deliveries/`: One dated folder per handover, frozen once sent.
- `finance/`: Money records for this job (`quotes/`, `invoices/`, `expenses/`).
- `archive/`: Close-out summary and final handover record.
- `tmp/`: Scratch space, ignored by Git and disposable.
- Anything that fits no folder above: ask where it goes; do not invent a new top-level folder.

### Rules

- Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- Keep this repo private; never push it to a public remote.
- Never change or delete existing files in `brief/`, `contract/`, `refs/` or `intake/`; new client files are added only as the next rule says.
- Files from the client go in `intake/YYYY-MM-DD/` unchanged; work on copies in `work/wip/`, and put disposable test exports and previews in `work/exports/`.
- Each review round gets a new `review/rNN/` (copy `review/_template/` for `review/rNN/sent/` and `review/rNN/feedback/`); `review/rNN/sent/` is frozen as soon as it is shared.
- Every feedback item becomes a line in that round's change list in `review/rNN/feedback/`, marked done or declined.
- A request not covered by `brief/` or `contract/` is logged in `comms/` and flagged; do not start it.
- Sending anything to the client needs approval.
- A delivery folder is `deliveries/YYYY-MM-DD_vN/` and is never modified after sending; put the close-out summary and final handover record in `archive/`.
- Creating or changing anything in `finance/` (`finance/quotes/`, `finance/invoices/`, `finance/expenses/`, `finance/timesheet.csv`) needs approval.
- Every third-party asset used must have a licence in `licences/`.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
<!-- kit:client-job end -->
